"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Switch as SwitchPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/switch" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" // Base UI className can be a state function; the wrapper feeds it to cn(), so // narrow it to a plain string (same treatment as the other ported files). type WithClassName

= Omit & { className?: string } const Switch = React.forwardRef< HTMLButtonElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) Switch.displayName = "Switch" export { Switch }
